purpose: Upgrade Swarm material and form language after feedback: no turquoise background, richer and more distinctive styling; preview only

variants.name: Inlay
variants.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Reference image role: shape and layout reference for the Swarm emblem of hgs zerus. The reference's turquoise-tinted background and inflated plastic rendering are specifically REJECTED by the user.
Keep the recognisable threefold Swarm arrangement: three curved outer hooked wings rotating around an open center, and three inner crescent inserts. Keep its rotational direction and visual balance. You MAY redesign the cross-sections, bevels, layered construction and material transitions to make it feel genuinely authored and distinctive. This is an art-direction upgrade, not a simple recolor.
Finished desktop app icon artwork, straight-on orthographic composition, centered, sculpted object occupying about 76–80% of a square canvas, ample breathing room.
BACKGROUND MUST BE PERFECTLY NEUTRAL CHARCOAL, RGB #171717, edge to edge. Black and neutral gray only in the background. Absolutely NO teal, cyan, green or blue tint to the background, no tinted ambient glow or colored vignette. No rounded-square tile drawn inside the image, no border or outer frame: the app will mask the square later.
Premium crafted materials, strong visual hierarchy, sophisticated controlled directional lighting, crisp deliberate planes and edges, intriguing large-scale structure. Depth should come from real layered construction and shaped facets, not a generic puffy bevel. No inflated plastic, gummy gel, flat clip-art, broad white airbrush streaks, fake chrome, glossy toy finish, visual noise or ornamental clutter. No text or letters, no UI, no stand, no watermark. One finished square icon, opaque background.
Direction 1 — INLAY / PRECISION OBJECT.
Rebuild each outer wing as a precisely crafted dark titanium skeleton with a narrow pale brushed-metal rim and a recessed deep turquoise enamel face. Clear material layering: thin bright cut edge, deep charcoal structural side, broad saturated petrol-jade inlay. The three inner crescents are luminous warm amber ceramic set into dark metal bezels, like small pieces of fine jewelry.
Use planar asymmetric chamfers and a couple of precise sculptural steps to make the curves feel engineered, NOT a smooth inflated rubber surface. Fine satin metal catches the neutral key light; restrained turquoise enamel has depth but little glare. Large clean material regions; elegant hard-surface industrial design, wearable technology meets alien artifact. Teal and warm amber contrast; no purple. Background remains strictly achromatic #171717.
